news.analysis: The Bucs managed to win a game where Mayfield did not complete a single pass as they ran for 324 yards as a team. This was the second time a team has completed zero passes in the Super Bowl era and the first time in over 50 years. Mayfield will be a QB2 play next week against the Bears.
